## plcinfo 2.0.0 🎉

A big release. plcinfo now **diffs ladder logic rung by rung**, **draws ladder diagrams**, plugs into **git**, and reads **real project files from all four vendors**. It was rebuilt against the official format specifications and tested on real exports.

### ✨ Highlights

- 🔍 **Logic-level diff.** `plcinfo diff` compares rungs, Structured Text lines, networks, routines and data types. Rungs are matched by content, so inserting one rung is reported as one addition rather than every later rung "changing". Changed rungs get an instruction-level summary such as `-OTE(Motor) +OTL(Motor)`. (#6)
- 🪜 **Ladder diagrams.** `plcinfo report` writes a self-contained HTML page with every rung drawn as a ladder diagram. `plcinfo diff --format html` shows changed rungs before and after, side by side, with removed instructions in red and added ones in green. (#15)
- 🔗 **Git integration.** Register `plcinfo textconv` as a git textconv driver, and `git diff`, `git log -p` and code review show logic changes instead of XML noise. (#7)
- 🧭 **Cross-reference.** `plcinfo xref` shows where every tag is read and written, including qualified GVL/DB access, `THIS^`/`SUPER^` and inherited members. Add `--writes` to find who drives an output. (#9, #14)
- 🧹 **Lint.** `plcinfo lint` finds duplicate `OTE`s, missing `JSR`/`FOR` targets, unreachable routines, leftover `AFI`s, unused tags, inhibited tasks and pending online edits. Use `--fail-on` to make it a CI gate. (#9)
- 📊 **CSV output** for Excel: `tags`, `io`, `search`, `diff`, `xref` and `lint`. (#10)

### 🏭 Vendor support

| Vendor | What's new |
|---|---|
| **Rockwell** | L5X follows the Logix 5000 Import/Export manual: UDTs, ST source, online-edit states, module slots, partial exports (#3, #4). **New: native `.ACD` reader** for controller, tags, programs, ladder rungs, tasks, AOIs, UDTs and modules, without Studio 5000. Its results are marked partial (#8). |
| **Siemens** | **New: TIA Portal Openness (SimaticML) exports.** LAD/FBD is rebuilt as readable power-flow logic, SCL from its tokens, plus STL, GRAPH, DBs, UDTs and tag tables. Standalone Step 7 `.awl`/`.scl` sources are also read. `.apXX`/`.zapXX` now explain how to export (#12). |
| **CODESYS / PLCopen** | Matches the TC6 schema: data types, task links, ST/IL source, **LD/FBD/CFC networks**, SFC summaries, CODESYS methods, properties, interfaces, GVLs and device tree. Also reads Beremiz, OpenPLC and ctrlX exports (#13). |
| **Beckhoff TwinCAT 3** | Reads **real projects**: `.tsproj` (tasks, EtherCAT I/O tree, variable links), `.plcproj` and `.TcPOU`/`.TcGVL`/`.TcDUT`/`.TcTTO`, including methods, properties, actions and DUTs (#11). |

### 🛠 CLI

- Consistent options on every command: `-f/--format`, `-o/--output`, `-q/--quiet`, `--verbose`, `-h/--help` (#5).
- stdout carries only results; warnings and errors go to stderr.
- Exit codes: `0` ok, `1` error, `2` usage error, `130` interrupted. `diff` follows `diff(1)`: 0 same, 1 different, 2 trouble.
- `--format json` now works as documented. In 1.0.0 only `Json` (capitalized) was accepted (#3).
- Output is the same in every locale (decimals, dates, Turkish `i`).

### ⚠️ Breaking changes

- `search` takes the query as a positional argument: `plcinfo search FILE QUERY`. `--text` still works but is hidden.
- `export -f neutral-json` is gone. Use `plcinfo export FILE` (JSON) or `-f yaml`, and `--compact` instead of `--indent false`. `--indent` still works but is hidden.
- `--version` prints `plcinfo <version>`. `-v` no longer means version.
- Usage errors now exit `2`, and `diff` exits `2` (not `1`) when a file can't be read.
- `.apXX`/`.zapXX`, binary CODESYS `.project`, and files that aren't real ACDs now fail with a clear message, instead of returning an empty project with exit code 0.

### 🐛 Notable fixes

- Ladder instructions were mis-parsed: tag names were counted as instructions, and operands were dropped (#3).
- `diff` missed changes to same-named tags in different scopes and to program-scoped tags, and slowed down quadratically with project size. 50k tags went from about 15 s to milliseconds (#3).
- Step 7 parsing silently returned empty projects because the Windows-1252 encoding wasn't registered (#3).
- `tags` never listed program-scoped tags (#10).

### 📦 Downloads

Self-contained single-file binaries; .NET doesn't need to be installed.

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows x64 | `plcinfo.exe` or `plcinfo-2.0.0-win-x64.zip` |
| Windows ARM64 | `plcinfo-2.0.0-win-arm64.zip` |
| Linux x64 / ARM64 | `plcinfo-2.0.0-linux-x64.tar.gz` / `plcinfo-2.0.0-linux-arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS Apple Silicon / Intel | `plcinfo-2.0.0-osx-arm64.tar.gz` / `plcinfo-2.0.0-osx-x64.tar.gz` |
| .NET tool | `plcinfo.2.0.0.nupkg` |

Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`. The macOS binaries aren't notarized; if Gatekeeper blocks them, run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine plcinfo`.

### 🧪 Quality

- 428 automated tests, run on Ubuntu and Windows for every pull request (#1). Builds treat warnings as errors.
- Real-world fixtures from Rockwell, Siemens, CODESYS, Beremiz, OpenPLC and Beckhoff projects. All are permissively licensed and credited in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
- Runs on .NET 10 LTS (#2).

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/adamfisher/plcinfo/compare/1.0.0...2.0.0
